business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Operations in Customs Free Trade Zones

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman - National Unitary Jurisdiction (including designated Free Zones: Duqm Special Economic Zone, Sohar Free Zone, Salalah Free Zone, Al Mazunah Free Zone)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - Codified civil-law style statutes (Commercial Companies Law, AML/CFT Law) with Sharia as a residual source of law and a strong Layer of ministerial regulations; not a common-law jurisdiction
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China-Oman Bilateral Investment Treaty (1995) - FET, expropriation protection and investor-state arbitration for Chinese shareholders
United States-Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force, effective 1 January 2009) - 100% foreign ownership and national treatment
China-Oman Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (in force)
India-Oman Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (in force)
GCC Unified Economic Agreement (Riyadh, 1981, as amended) - GCC national treatment framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (Law on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism - 'AML/CFT Law') as implemented by its Executive Regulations and supervisory guidance of the National Centre for Financial Information (NCFI), the Omani FIU; Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law) imposing the identification, recording, and continuous updating of beneficial owners in an internal UBO register; Foreign Capital Investment Law, Royal Decree No. 50/2019 (as amended, permitting 100% foreign ownership outside the door closed list); Commercial Register Law (Royal Decree No. 3/2019); Central Bank of Oman KYC/CDD circulars; and the MoCIIP electronic UBO filing module on the Invest Easy platform.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (restricted register: UBO particulars are filed with MoCIIP and shared with NCFI, ROP Customs, Oman Tax Authority and licensed financial institutions under lawful disclosure; not publicly searchable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate sole shareholder (where applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies / Companies Registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the origin state is a Contracting Party to the Hague Convention of 5 October 1961; otherwise Consular Legalization via the Omani Embassy/Consulate with subsequent Omani MFA ratification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the licensed Omani corporate services agent to execute pre-incorporation filings and name reservation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; where unavailable, Consular Legalization through the Omani mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of the natural-person sole shareholder and each ultimate beneficial owner holding 25% or more
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the origin jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization in jurisdictions not party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter evidencing source of funds for the initial capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization; where the bank attaches a notarized certificate, the Hague Apostille path may be used

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Arabic translation of the constitutive documents (Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, and the notarized Power of Attorney)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed legal translator in Oman sworn before the Omani Notary Public / Ministry of Justice
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic Omani notarization without an additional Apostille; the original apostilled or consularized source texts must be attached

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory under the AML/CFT Law and CBO KYC rules: screen all UBOs, directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists (1267/1988 and successor regimes), the OFAC SDN List, the UK/EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, the domestic Omani terrorist list issued by NCFI, and INTERPOL notices; classify Politically Exposed Persons (domestic and foreign) and apply Enhanced Due Diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds certification, for 12 months after a PEP vacates office; conduct negative-media screening and FATF Public Statement high-risk-jurisdiction checks prior to bank account opening for the SWIFT/Wire and local-clearing payment rails; the bonded-depot operation is internally rated 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced' for sectoral AML risk.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy - the official consolidated e-services licensing portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) at https://investeasy.gov.om; free-zone applicants additionally pass through the relevant zone one-stop shop (Duqm SEZ, Sohar Free Zone, Salalah Free Zone), all of which interoperate with the central MoCIIP commercial-name index.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Commercial Register operates in Arabic; the proposed name must be filed in Arabic and the Arabic version prevails as the official registered name. A Latin-script transliteration may be appended as a secondary trade name. For foreign-owned SPCs in free zones, the free-zone license may be issued in English while the MoCIIP commercial registration retains the mandatory Arabic name. Names must not be identical, phonetically confusable, or confusingly similar to an existing registered name or protected trademark, must not mislead as to governmental patronage, and must not contravene public order or Sharia.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names implying royal, governmental, or sovereign patronage: 'Royal', 'Sultan', 'Diwan', 'Court', 'Ministry', 'Government', 'Municipality', 'Sultanate'
Financial sector tokens requiring prior CBO or CMA approval and normally prohibited for a Standard SPC: 'Bank', 'Finance', 'Investment', 'Insurance', 'Reinsurance', 'Takaful', 'Exchange'
Names of international organizations or foreign governments: 'United Nations', 'World Bank', 'IMF', 'OECD', 'Red Cross', 'WHO'
Terms reserved for strategic or public-utility sectors: 'Petroleum', 'Gas', 'Electricity', 'Telecommunications' when they imply state participation
Legal-form designations inconsistent with the SPC vehicle: 'Public Joint Stock Company', 'Holding', 'Limited Partnership', 'Association'
Offensive, religiously contemptuous, or morally objectionable expressions contrary to Omani public order and Sharia
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 15 business days of the electronic rejection notice in Invest Easy, the applicant files a formal objection through the registry ticket channel, attaching: (i) a legal opinion on visual and phonetic distinctiveness; (ii) the proposed Arabic vocalization (tashkeel) that differentiates the name; and (iii) any priority or first-use evidence. If the Commercial Registry Department upholds the rejection, the applicant may escalate to the Undersecretary for Commercial Registration. Exhaustion of the administrative appeal is followed by an annulment application to the Omani Administrative Court within 60 days of the final administrative decision. To avoid delay, the applicant may simultaneously re-file with a modified distinctive token; the 30-day reservation clock is automatically tolled while an appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the statutory seat for this industry. The MoCIIP commercial register and the free-zone authority require a physical leasehold registered address in Oman. A virtual office or mail-forwarding business center may serve only as a supplementary correspondence address and cannot satisfy the ROP Customs bonded-premises licensing requirement, which mandates a physical depot and operating presence within the free zone or customs bonded area.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - approximately 85-90% probability of at least one unannounced joint inspection by ROP Customs, the free-zone authority, and the Oman Tax Authority within the first 12 months of operation. Monthly or quarterly inventory surveillance is standard for bonded depots classified as 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced'; fire-safety and operational-substance checks are also conducted without prior warning.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Oman Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019 as amended by Royal Decree No. 87/2021 (including the Single Person Company chapter); Foreign Capital Investment Law, Royal Decree No. 50/2019 (permitting 100% foreign ownership); Commercial Registration Law, Royal Decree No. 3/1983, as amended; and applicable GCC Unified Customs Law provisions for free zone bonded operations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Commercial Registry, operating through the 'Invest Easy' e-portal and integrated with the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ) one-stop shop for zone-licensed companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Commercial Registration Application (Company Incorporation Form) filed via the MoCIIP Invest Easy portal, accompanied by the notarized Single Person Company Model Articles of Association, the free zone preliminary license, premises lease, and the share subscription declaration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a Single Person Company under Royal Decree No. 18/2019 as amended; the Articles of Association must state the subscribed capital and the sole shareholder must fully pay the subscribed capital within the period fixed therein. The free zone authority may require a bank certificate evidencing adequate working capital or a bond threshold (commonly OMR 3,000–10,000) proportionate to the bond operations, and paid-up capital may be held in an ordinary corporate bank account in the Company's name rather than a statutory escrow account unless the zone authority so directs.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the incorporation of the Company under the Oman Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended) be approved; that the subscription of the entire issued share capital by the Sole Shareholder be ratified as stated in the Articles of Association; that the registered office be fixed at the free zone bonded depot premises recorded in the Commercial Registration; that [Name], [Name] and [Name] be appointed Chairman, General Manager and Company Secretary, each with banking signatory authority and statutory filing powers; that the officers execute all filings and licenses required by MoCIIP, OPAZ, the Tax Authority, PASI and CDAA; that the corporate seal, share certificates and statutory registers be procured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve the Proposed Trade Name with the National Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Invest Easy e-portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the Invest Easy portal, complete the name reservation request, and submit three ranked proposed trade names (Arabic and English) with legal form 'Single Person Company'. Pay the applicable examination fee. The reserved name certificate is valid for sixty calendar days and must be used in the subsequent incorporation filing. The name must not conflict with existing commercial registrations, protected marks, or sacred/Omani public-order references.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder (and authorized signatory)
Notarized power of attorney if a corporate representative files
Three ranked trade name options (Arabic/English)
Valid e-mail and mobile number for the portal user account
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for conflict or semantic reasons, submit alternative ranked names through the same portal session; no formal appeal is necessary for selecting a different compliant name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Secure Bonded Warehouse Premises and Obtain Free Zone Preliminary License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ) – respective Zone Authority one-stop window (e.g., Duqm SEZAD, Sohar Free Zone, or Salalah Free Zone)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Negotiate and execute a lease or right-of-use agreement for the bonded depot plot or unit within the free zone. Submit the bonded warehouse operations plan (security fencing, CCTV coverage, access control, and segregation of bonded versus non-bonded goods) to the Zone Authority. Upon approval, receive the Preliminary License or zone clearance confirming the permitted bonded storage use and customs-territory status of the premises.
required_dossiers: Approved trade name certificate
Bonded warehouse business plan
Lease or right-of-use agreement
Preliminary floor plan showing bonded/non-bonded segregation
Passport copies of beneficial owner and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preliminary license is queried, revise the operational plan to strengthen physical security and customs supervision controls, then resubmit to the Zone Authority licensing committee through the one-stop centre.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare, Execute and Notarize the Single Person Company Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public, Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs (Oman); Omani diplomatic mission for attestation of foreign corporate documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the MoCIIP standard form (Model Articles of Association) inserting the sole shareholder's capital contribution, share percentage, and management provisions. Execute the Articles together with the SPC incorporation and share subscription declaration. The sole shareholder's signature must be notarized before an Omani Notary Public. If the shareholder is a foreign legal entity, attest the board resolution and certificate of incorporation through the Omani Embassy/consulate and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs before notarization.
required_dossiers: Model Articles of Association duly completed and signed
Share subscription declaration
Passport/ID copies of sole shareholder and directors
Attested corporate documents if shareholder is a legal entity
Name certificate and free zone preliminary license/lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary queries attestation, rectify the missing legalization chain at the Omani consular post and resubmit; any substantive change to the Articles requires a supplementary incorporation resolution and renewed notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Commercial Registration Application and Obtain the Commercial Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Commercial Registry via Invest Easy portal or the Zone One-Stop Centre
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the online Company Incorporation application attaching the notarized Articles of Association, name certificate, free zone preliminary license, lease, and identification documents. Declare the subscribed and paid-up capital and pay the statutory registration and gazette publication fees. Upon verification, MoCIIP issues the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate, thereby establishing the legal personality of the SPC.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Trade name reservation certificate
Free zone preliminary license and lease
Passport copies and photographs of managers/directors
Paid-up capital bank certificate (if requested by the authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, correct the flagged data fields and resubmit within the name validity period; unresolved substantive objections may be appealed in writing to the Director of Commercial Registration with supporting evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Civil Defense and Occupational Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) under the Royal Oman Police, with zone building control coordination
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed depot fit-out and fire-safety file including architectural plans, fire suppression and alarm calculations, racking load calculations, exit routes, and evacuation plan. Undergo an on-site inspection of the bonded premises. Obtain the Fire and Life Safety Certificate and the occupational clearance certificate, both of which are mandatory prerequisites for the customs bonded warehouse license and final zone operating permit.
required_dossiers: Approved architectural and fire protection drawings
Fire suppression and alarm system design (NFPA/GCC Fire Code compliance)
Structural load calculation for racking and mezzanine areas
Emergency evacuation plan
Commercial Registration certificate (draft or issued)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify identified deficiencies within the prescribed correction period (maximum thirty days) and request a re-inspection; where code interpretation is disputed, submit an equivalency study prepared by a licensed fire protection engineer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register for Tax Obligations with the Oman Tax Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) – Taxpayer Registration Directorate and Customs Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the income tax registration via the OTA e-service portal using the Commercial Registration number. Register for VAT where projected annual taxable supplies exceed OMR 38,500 (approximately USD 100,000) or where the zone operations require voluntary registration. Upon registration, obtain the Tax Card/registration certificate. The free zone bonded warehouse customs code is linked to the zone identifier in the customs system for duty suspension and periodic audit purposes.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
Notarized Articles of Association and lease
Passport copies of shareholders and directors
Bank account opening certificate of the SPC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is rejected due to data mismatch, first correct the CR record at MoCIIP and resubmit with the corrected CR extract; customs-related objections are addressed in writing to the OTA Customs Directorate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Employing Entity with the Social Insurance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI) – Employer Registration e-services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the employer file in the PASI e-services portal using the Commercial Registration number, Tax Card, and the General Manager's appointment decision. Enroll all initial employees with their wage declarations and labour cards. Confirm that the Company will withhold and remit social insurance contributions at the applicable statutory rates for Omani and GCC national employees as mandated by law.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
Tax registration card
Lease and premises document
Employment contracts and passports for initial employees
General Manager appointment decision
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct wage and employee records and resubmit; any missing CR detail is reconciled through the automated data link between PASI and the MoCIIP Commercial Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Secure the Customs Bonded Warehouse License and Final Free Zone Operating Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority – Customs Directorate, jointly with the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the bonded warehouse license application together with the final zone operations permit request. Attach the Commercial Registration, CDAA safety certificate, floor plans, security layout, and a bonded warehousing procedures manual covering goods receipt, storage, transfer, re-export, and inventory audit trail. Upon approval, the depot is assigned a customs warehouse code enabling duty-suspension handling, transit movements, and periodic customs audits; concurrently, OPAZ issues the final Free Zone Operating License authorizing commercial bonded storage operations.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
CDAA fire and life safety certificate
Free zone preliminary license and final application form
Bonded warehouse procedures manual
CCTV/security and stock control system description
Inventory and audit trail forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the customs license is queried, enhance the stock-control and bonding arrangements (e.g., physical segregation, monthly inventory returns, independent stock audit) and resubmit; a formal refusal may be appealed to the Director General of Customs and thereafter to the internal review committee of the Oman Tax Authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ) – Free Zone Licensing Directorate, with customs concurrence from the Oman Tax Authority (Customs Directorate)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Free Zone Operating License (Bonded Warehouse/Depot Storage Class) and Customs Bonded Warehouse Permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman – Environmental Licensing Directorate
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 (Environmental Activity Registration) for a covered bonded depot; a scoped Preliminary Environmental Review is triggered if the depot exceeds 10,000 m² or is located near coastal, residential, or protected receptors; otherwise exempt from a Full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial process effluent; sanitary sewage discharged only to an approved municipal network or via on-site treatment meeting BOD5 ≤ 25 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L and pH 6–8.5; stormwater from handling and parking areas must be contained and treated to Omani prescribed standards with oil and grease ≤ 10 mg/L prior to any offsite release; no volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions expected from pure storage, and combustible vapor concentrations must remain below 25% of the Lower Explosive Limit within the storage hall; all forklifts and material handling equipment must comply with applicable national emission limits; hazardous waste (e.g., used oils, contaminated absorbents) must be segregated, labelled, and dispatched through Environment Authority-licensed carriers under an executed waste manifest as required by the Environmental Protection and Pollution Control Law, Royal Decree No. 114/2001.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: CDAA (Royal Oman Police) Fire and Life Safety Certificate: suppression system design reviewed against NFPA and GCC Fire Code requirements; fire hydrant, extinguisher and alarm coverage verified for the warehouse envelope; structural load certificate from a licensed civil engineer confirming racking and mezzanine load capacities; occupational safety clearance covering emergency exits, evacuation signage, ventilation, lighting, and hazardous-substance segregation; annual recertification is mandatory, and a pre-opening on-site inspection must be completed before the bonded depot commences operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) - General Authority for Taxation - official e-services portal: https://tax.gov.om (OTA Tax Portal). Customs administration is exercised by the Royal Oman Police - Customs Directorate through the single-window Bayan system; business incorporation is handled by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) via the Invest Easy portal; free-zone licensing is issued by the respective free zone authorities (Salalah Free Zone, Sohar Free Zone, Al-Mazunah Free Zone, Khazaen Economic City, and Duqm Special Economic Zone).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 - Incorporate the Single Person Company (SPC) through the Invest Easy portal (MCIIP) to obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate with the precise bonded-warehouse activity classification under ISIC 5210; Step 2 - Apply to the Oman Tax Authority for the Corporate Tax Number (Tax Card/TIN) within 3 months of commencing business, submitting the CR, free-zone operating licence, audited opening balance sheet, lease or usufruct agreement, and passport/POA copies of the sole shareholder and directors; Step 3 - For bonded depots located inside a Free Trade Zone, first obtain the Free Zone Operating Licence (which incorporates Customs Bonded Warehouse registration) and then file the CIT tax registration with the OTA citing the free-zone licence number; Step 4 - Submit the VAT registration application (Form VAT-001) through the OTA e-Services Portal within 30 days after the mandatory registration threshold is met or is reasonably expected to be met, and receive the VAT Registration Number (VRN); foreign entities with no physical Omani establishment may be required to appoint a resident tax representative for VAT filing and service of process.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the SPC is a resident juridical person and is mandatorily taxed at the entity level on worldwide income. Oman CIT headline rates: 3% on taxable income up to OMR 100,000 (only for Omani-majority SMEs) and 15% on income above OMR 100,000; a 100% foreign-owned SPC normally falls outside the SME reduced rate and faces the flat 15% CIT. Free Trade Zone entities receive a statutory CIT exemption of 10-30 years (renewable for 15 additional years in Duqm SEZ) on qualifying zone-source income, conditional on maintaining audited free-zone books, satisfying the substance requirements, and complying with the free-zone licensing conditions; however, the exemption is territorial and does not extend to sales made into the Omani customs territory or to services consumed in Oman. For VAT purposes, the free-zone bonded depot operates under the outside-the-scope-of-VAT carve-out for goods entering and leaving the zone, although taxable supplies made from the zone into Oman attract VAT at the statutory rate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not operate a check-the-box pass-through election; the SPC is unambiguously an entity-level taxpayer under the Tax Procedure Law (RD 62/2023) and the Income Tax Law (RD 28/2009, as amended). Available statutory elections: (a) VAT Grouping election for related parties under Article 41 of the VAT Law (RD 121/2020), permitting the bonded-depot SPC to aggregate VAT liabilities with its parent or sister entities; (b) HIVA election for VAT return frequency - monthly filing may be elected by exporters and zero-rated suppliers to obtain speedier refunds, otherwise quarterly filing is the default; (c) irrevocable election to apply the free-zone outside-the-scope VAT treatment on goods warehoused in the bonded depot pending export; (d) election to zero-rate (rather than exempt or outside-scope) qualifying supplies of storage, handling, and inspection services used in connection with export; (e) CIT tax-loss carry-forward election allowing losses to be carried forward for 5 years, subject to formal continuity-of-business documentation; (f) no hybrid-mismatch or reverse-hybrid election is available under Omani domestic law, and the OECD BEPS Action 2 hybrid rules apply as a default mandatory rule.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) - GCC Unified VAT Agreement enacted into Omani domestic law by Royal Decree No. 121/2020 (VAT Law) and the VAT Executive Regulations (Decision No. 53/2021), effective 16 April 2021; administered by the Oman Tax Authority.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration threshold: OMR 500,000 of cumulative taxable supplies, imports, and taxable expenses in the preceding 12 months or reasonably expected in the next 30 days. Voluntary registration threshold: OMR 250,000. A bonded depot operator dealing exclusively in zero-rated export goods is strongly advised to voluntarily register at the OMR 250,000 threshold to enable input VAT recovery on warehousing, security, forklifts, and utility costs; free-zone entities may also be required to register for VAT irrespective of turnover to report outside-the-scope flows on the OTA portal.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman has adopted a mandatory electronic-invoicing regime (OTA E-Invoicing Project) on a phased implementation calendar running from 2025 to 2027. The regime uses a centralized real-time clearance model: every B2B VAT invoice must be transmitted to the OTA fiscal network via a certified API gateway (JSON/XML schema) before issuance to the buyer; a digital stamp (QR code) is generated and embedded in the final PDF/XML invoice; invoices without the OTA-cleared fiscal stamp are not valid for input VAT deduction. Phase 1 (2025) applies to taxpayers with turnover above OMR 20 million, Phase 2 (2026) to taxpayers above OMR 1 million, and Phase 3 (2027) to all VAT-registered persons. The system supports e-invoicing and e-reporting streams (either full clearance or batch reporting); ERP integration mandates use of OTA-certified accounting or fiscal modules, and the introduction of electronic bills of lading and free-zone gate passes may be cross-referenced by the OTA audit engine.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for: (1) goods physically exported from Oman to a non-GCC destination within 90 days of the date of supply, evidenced by an approved Customs export Bayan; (2) goods removed from an Omani free trade zone and re-exported to third countries (the initial supply into the bonded depot and the final exportation are both treated as zero-rated or outside-scope as long as no taxable use in Oman occurs); (3) goods supplied in free zones to a licensed bonded warehouse operator for the sole purpose of eventual re-export; (4) directly related services rendered in connection with the export of goods - including handling, storage, packing, labeling, inspection, freight, insurance, and loading services - provided the services are purchased by the exporter or by a person outside Oman; (5) transport of goods to a destination outside the GCC. To claim zero-rating, the supplier must retain a complete Proof of Export file for 5 years, maintain the VAT invoice stating the zero-rated nature of the supply, and, if the goods are physically stored in a bonded depot, ensure the depot's stock ledger reconciles with the customs entry/exit records. Any missed documentary element shifts the supply back to the standard 5% rate at the date of original invoice.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan) approved by the Royal Oman Police - Customs, bearing a unique Movement Reference Number (MRN), evidencing exit from the free zone and sea/air export from Omani territory
Bill of Lading (negotiable or telex release) or Air Waybill, or multimodal transport document, showing the consignee and foreign destination port, cross-referenced to the Bayan

Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Omani commercial bank, evidencing that the export proceeds in foreign currency have been credited to the SPC's bank account in Oman within the statutory repatriation window
Free Trade Zone Warehouse Entry/Exit Gate Pass and the bonded depot stock movement register, reconciled with the customs Bayan and the VAT invoices
Commercial Export Invoice and Packing List, cross-referenced to the VAT zero-rated invoice number, Bayan number, and the free-zone exit gate pass
Certificate of Origin (Oman Chamber of Commerce) or EUR-1/Form A, where applicable, supporting the customs treatment at the destination country
Insurance certificate and freight invoice (if retained by the seller), and any letter of credit or sales contract evidencing the underlying foreign transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The OTA executes post-clearance export verification audits by matching VAT returns against Customs Bayans, free-zone stock registers, and the OTA e-invoicing clearance database. If the Proof of Export file is found incomplete, altered, or non-reconcilable, the zero-rated treatment is retroactively reversed and output VAT is assessed from the original invoice date (not the audit date), compounding late-payment penalties at 1% per month plus a fixed OMR 200 penalty per outstanding return. Willful false zero-rating claims constitute tax evasion under the Anti-Tax Evasion Law (RD 28/2008): fines up to OMR 10,000, imprisonment of up to 3 years for the responsible directors/manager, publication of the taxpayer's name, and mandatory blacklisting from OTA free-zone incentive programs. Customs penalties of up to triple the evaded customs duty may be separately imposed by ROP Customs. The OTA may also claw back input VAT credits claimed on costs attributable to the export activity, and the free-zone operator's 10-30 year CIT exemption is subject to revocation retroactively for the entire audit period where the bonded depot fails the economic-substance and eligible-activity tests. In addition, failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days triggers exchange-control penalties from the Central Bank of Oman and may void the IRC-based proof of export, resulting in simultaneous VAT clawback and customs violations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Rial Omani (OMR) is fully convertible for current account transactions, including trade settlement, service fees, and profit remittances, subject to documentary verification by licensed banks. Capital account flows, including inbound direct investment into a 100% foreign-owned SPC, are permissible with an approved purpose code and require maintaining supporting documentation. There is no foreign exchange law blocking profit repatriation; however, banks apply standard know-your-client and anti-money-laundering checks, and the Oman Tax Authority must issue a clearance certificate before material dividend remittances. No beyond-resident statutory conversion of FX is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds. A Free Zone bonded depot operator may retain foreign currency receipts in a CBO-licensed foreign currency account or convert as desired. The licensed bank is obligated to report export flow data to the CBO's statistics and balance-of-payments system, and exporters must retain customs warehouse evidence and underlying sales contracts to ensure banks' AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Multi-Currency Account
Cross-Border Treasury and Trade Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMIs are a Low primary viability for this official bonded depot because the SPC needs a CBO-regulated relationship, documentary credit capacity, and direct access to Omani local clearing. An offshore EMI may be used only as an ancillary collection or disbursement tool where it holds a FATF-rated license, provides transparent audit trails, and the SPC still maintains its main liquidity ors and trade-finance rail at an Omani commercial bank. Banks additionally impose ultimate beneficial owner transparency and may reject flows from EMIs that are not licensed as credit institutions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical KYC interview is standardly mandatory for directors and beneficial owners at a Tier-1 Omani bank. Remote opening is rarely available for a newly foreign-owned Free Zone SPC without a recognized branch relationship or a successful video KYC exception, but conservative practice requires at least one authorized director or senior company manager to appear physically in Oman. A valid Civil ID, original passport, and attested incorporation/registration documents are required; apostilled copies may be accepted where Oman has a bilateral attestation treaty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex Ultimate Beneficial Ownership involving a foreign parent or transparent holding structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Organisational chart, UBO declaration, passport/ID, source of wealth and source of funds evidence, bank/CB reference, and certified constitutional documents

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tight deadline or FastTrack account opening without physical presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized power of attorney, apostilled Board resolution, qualified officer directorship appointment form, and advance email assurance with bank's Compliance pre-approval memo

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected rapid volume of cross-border trade settlements that exceeds stated business turnover
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bonded warehouse production projections, provisional sales/purchase agreements, inventory capacity certificates, and an explanation of seasonal or trade-driven surges

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of cash or clustering of cash deposits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cash-flow policy, source declaration, traceable bank/cashier receipts, replenishment of petty cash, and compliance officers' approval memo

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transactions involving high-risk or sanctioned counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence, CIP, negative/positive screening, official OFAC/UN/customs/BIS licenses if applicable, and independent legal opinion

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of high-risk jurisdiction or discrepancy in revenue source
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of customer invoices/packing lists, customs bond entries, country of origin certificates, transportation manifests, and an economic rationale narrative

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection must be routed via a licensed Omani commercial bank using SWIFT with clear purpose code for direct investment (generally GFI or 101). Funds should be received into a capital/escrow account before use. Wires must show the ultimate investor as originating beneficiary; evidence includes a subscribed capital statement, board resolution, and certified copies of the investor's ID. For a SPC, the shareholder's bank must issue a notarized source-of-funds letter, and Omani inward investment reporting is triggered at the bank level. viz. no legal restrictions on 100% foreign direct ownership, but CBO reporting and anti-money-laundering verification apply.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for bonded warehouse operations are effected via SWIFT MT103/MT202, or by commercial LCs (UCP600/URDG758 guarantees) where the supporting commercial documentation is consistent. For OMR domestic clearing, the CBO runs CLS (CLS of Oman) allowing cleared funds between local banks. Banking transactions must have a clear operating purpose, proper invoice/contract, structuring, and timely settlement to avoid overdraft or overdraft liquidity classification.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward OMR/USD or USD/OMR contracts with licensed banks or brokers
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) where permitted through CBO-licensed banks

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the Commercial Registration ('CR') certificate for the Single Person Company (SPC) under Commercial Companies Law (Sultani Decree 18/2019)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — Companies Registration Directorate / InvestEasy one-stop shop
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date of the CR certificate's date of issuance; renewal application and fee must be submitted on or before expiry; FTZ-based SPCs on calendar-year lease cycles align renewal to 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee OMR 1.50 per day capped at OMR 500 (approx. USD 1,300); after 90 days the CR is flagged and all e-Government company services are suspended; after 6 months of non-renewal MoCIIP commences ex-officio administrative strike-off and dissolution of the SPC

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the Free Zone Operating License and the Bonded Warehouse ('Bonded Depot') activity license (ISIC 5210 / bonded custody of customs-controlled goods)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Applicable Omani Free Zone or Special Economic Zone authority (Oman Free Zones and Economic Zones Authority 'OFZEA'; Duqm SEZ Authority 'SEZAD'; Sohar or Salalah FTZ) jointly with Royal Oman Police Directorate General of Customs for the bonded license endorsement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual anniversary of the zone license issuance date; zones operating on a calendar-year basis require renewal by 31 December; administrative grace period of 60 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Immediate suspension of bonded status on lapse: removal of the bonded warehouse code from customs systems, full import duty/VAT payable on all in-bond stock, zone occupancy rights forfeited, and the MoCIIP Commercial Registration becomes non-operational

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax ('CIT') return on worldwide income of the Omani-resident SPC (self-assessment computation with tax schedule and calculated tax due)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (income-tax directorate) — eTax digital filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 6 months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SPC by 30 June of the following year; no administrative extension mechanism for commercial SPCs except insolvency or force majeure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine OMR 500 (approx. USD 1,300); late-payment monthly surcharge on outstanding tax capped at 100% of tax due; extended default triggers official assessment at a discretionary estimated basis and suspension of CR renewal services

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory external audit report (auditor's opinion) together with audited financial statements approved by sole shareholder resolution and filed as an annex to the CIT return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (eTax annex); MoCIIP register audit inspection; FTZ authority license-compliance review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audited financial statements must be available within 4 months after fiscal year-end (30 April for calendar-year SPC) and filed with Oman Tax Authority by the CIT deadline of 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Submission without the mandatory auditor certification invalidates the annual tax filing and attracts an OMR 500 penalty; directors are jointly liable for undeclared tax; MoCIIP register audit may impose daily penalty rates until audited records are deposited

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit by an Omani-licensed auditor is compulsory if annual gross revenue exceeds OMR 30,000 (approx. USD 78,000), gross assets exceed OMR 150,000, or 31 or more employees are engaged at any point; an FTZ-licensed SPC operating a bonded depot under ISIC 5210 is audited as a zone-license condition regardless of turnover, and the CIT return must reference an audited basis to be accepted for Oman Tax Authority self-assessment
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full International Financial Reporting Standards ('IFRS') as the statutory measurement framework for Oman corporate law and tax filings; small standalone SPCs below OMR 1 million revenue may use the IFRS-for-SMEs-aligned 'Omani GAAP' basis with parent-consolidation/FTZ-authority waiver; bonded stock must be costed under IAS 2 (FIFO or weighted-average) to reconcile with customs declarations

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Oman's AML/CFT Law and MoCIIP Beneficial Owner Disclosure Rules, the SPC maintains a Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners and confirms its accuracy annually in the CR-renewal digital form; any share transfer resulting in a 10% or greater change of ownership or change of entity-level effective control must be notified to the Commercial Register within 15 days; as a 100% foreign-owned free-zone SPC, the annual confirmation is accompanied by passport evidence, corporate-chart/KYC records, and zone authority proof of economic substance in the bonded depot
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 - USD 3,000 typical annual fee for registered office, PO Box, and licensed registered agent/company secretary in Muscat or at the FTZ service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 7,000 for a certified external audit of a free-zone bonded depot SPC, reflecting bonded-stock count and customs reconciliation procedures

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory rate tiers: 0% on the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income and 15% on the excess, effective for tax years beginning on or after 1 January 2023 (Sultan Decree 7/2023). Free-zone licensed Single Person Company operating a bonded depot is eligible for a 0% corporate income tax holiday of 10 years from licensing, renewable up to 20 years in designated free zones (e.g., Sohar, Salalah, Mazunah) and up to 30 years in the Duqm Special Economic Zone. The holiday requires substantive licensed operations inside the zone; no withholding tax is imposed on dividend distributions from the exempt entity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (OTA) filed through the Oman Tax Authority electronic portal, Tax Oman (https://www.taxoman.gov.om); Form: Income Tax Return for Bodies Corporate (self-assessment) together with Transfer Pricing Disclosure Annexure.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months from the end of the fiscal year; e.g., for a 31 December year-end, the return is due no later than 30 June of the following year. Free-zone entities with a 0% holiday remain obliged to register and file an exempt return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Identification Number (TIN), Commercial Registration number, Free Zone licence number, date of incorporation, legal form (Single Person Company), registered address and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Omani SPC is the filing taxpayer; the non-resident sole shareholder is not a co-filer but must ensure the SPC's CR and free-zone licence records continually reflect the true beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year start and end dates, accounting basis (accrual), applicable financial reporting standards and currency of accounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Accounts maintained in a foreign currency require prior OTA acceptance; conversion to OMR must follow Central Bank of Oman published rates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Residency status of the SPC, nationality of the single shareholder, and worldwide income declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An Omani-incorporated SPC is resident in Oman irrespective of the foreign residence of its sole shareholder; all foreign and Oman-source income is reportable unless expressly exempted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claim for zero-rate treatment under the free-zone tax holiday, including zone name, licence commencement date, holiday end date and proof of continuing substantive warehouse operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the Free Zone Authority licence, lease on physical warehouse premises, customs bonded-depot registration, and periodic substance fulfilment evidence, e.g., staff contracts and inventory records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross income from bonded warehouse services: storage, handling, repacking, customs clearances, consolidated logistics and incidental supply-chain reconstitution services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sham or artificially shifted revenue outside the licensed depot is rejected; the OTA may reclassify invoices and reattribute profit to the SPC if no real operations exist.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs wholly and exclusively incurred for the bonded-depot trade: warehousing rent, salaries, utilities, depreciation, security, insurance, professional fees and licences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border management charges to the overseas parent are deductible only where supported by an arm's-length agreement, actual services delivered, documents, and Transfer Pricing disclosure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fines, bribes-adjacent payments, excessive entertainment, unrealised provisions, general bad debts, and charges failing economic substance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to the sole shareholder or affiliate without TP documentation are disallowed; the OTA will add them back and may impose surcharges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Available losses per inception year, utilisation in the current year, and expiry tracking. Maximum carryforward is 5 years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses incurred during the free-zone holiday period are generally not transferred to the post-holiday taxable period unless the entity remained within the taxable net; document the calculation defensively.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory rate application: taxable income up to OMR 100,000 at 0%; the remainder at 15%. Credit for foreign taxes, prepayments and final tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident single shareholder cannot offset personal foreign tax credits against the Omani corporate liability; the SPC is taxed at entity level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 10 — Withholding Tax and TP Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Summary schedule of payments to non-residents liable to Omani withholding tax (royalties, interest, services, management fees) and declaration of connected-party transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: WHT liabilities attach to the payer; a non-resident beneficiary seeking treaty relief must file a residency certificate and beneficial ownership declaration before any reduced rate is applied.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed penalty of OMR 1,000 plus an additional daily surcharge regime and monthly late-payment charge of 2% on the outstanding tax. Failure to register within 3 months of licence issuance triggers a separate OMR 500 fine. Penalties for false declarations include up to 100% of the evaded tax plus imprisonment of up to 5 years and a fine of up to OMR 10,000. OTA may reopen assessments for 5 years (or unlimited for deliberate evasion).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Oman imposes no statutory dividend withholding tax; therefore, profit distributions by an Omani SPC to a foreign sole shareholder are remitted without Omani dividend WHT. For payments that are subject to statutory WHT (royalties, interest, management/technical services), treaty relief is granted solely through the Oman Tax Authority procedure: (i) recipient must secure an original or certified Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the foreign tax authority covering the payment period; (ii) the non-resident completes the OTA Withholding Tax Treaty Relief Declaration and beneficial ownership statement; (iii) the Omani SPC withholders must submit the TRC and relevant contract before remittance; (iv) the reduced or zero treaty rate applies only upon OTA acceptance; where no DTA applies, statutory 10% WHT is withheld at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 10% on royalties, licence fees, interest, technical assistance, management and consulting fees paid to non-residents. Interest paid to non-resident lenders on certain banking facilities may be exempt if the lender is a licensed bank, and interest on commercial trade credit for under six months is domestic exemption territory. Under Oscar DTA convention, royalty and interest WHT is generally reduced to 0% or 10% depending on the treaty partner; the non-resident must substantiate beneficial ownership and submit a TRC before any reduced rate is applied.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory where the annual aggregate value of controlled transactions (purchases, storage fees, warehousing charges, interest, management costs) between the Omani SPC and related parties exceeds OMR 500,000. Master File required where the group-wide Oman-related connected-party transactions exceed OMR 3,000,000 and the group's consolidated revenue exceeds OMR 37,500,000. Country-by-Country (CbC) Report required for groups with consolidated revenue of OMR 375,000,000 or above, under OTA Ministerial Decision No. 44/2021 incorporating the OECD three-tier documentation principle.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations code comparable to the UAE. However, economic substance is enforced through four channels: (i) free-zone licensing and customs-bonded warehouse statutes require an actual physical depot, resident warehouse manager, licensed customs bond, and regular inventory turnover within the zone; (ii) the Oman Tax Authority applies general anti-avoidance rules and place-of-effective-management concepts under Sultan Decree 7/2023 to disregard shell arrangements without people, premises and operations; (iii) controlled foreign company rules attribute undistributed low-taxed offshore profits to an Omani controlling shareholder where no genuine economic activities support the foreign structure; and (iv) treaty entitlement is denied where the recipient lacks beneficial ownership or a substantive business reason for holding the Omani SPC.
